issuesFixed: Optional Supabase values now map explicit undefined patches to SQL null so edit forms can actually clear fields.
The mobile form action bar no longer overlays essential inputs.
Future next-touch dates now use the correct relative-date sign.
Server validation failures now return a serializable FormData snapshot so non-error fields remain populated without putting contact data in the URL.
Added coverage for invalid email, self-referral, orphan notes, and relative-date language.
